title: Text and tiles on a photo
description: A photo across the section under a shade, the words on one side and up to four glass tiles on the other: an icon or a figure, a label, a line.

schema.label: Heading
schema.help: Two equals signs around words set them off: Homes ==by the river==.

schema.label: Tiles
schema.help: Up to four, two by two beside the words on a wide screen and under them on a phone. A tile with nothing in it is not shown.

children.label: Icon
children.help: An SVG takes the colour of the words, so one file reads on both shades; another picture is shown as it is.

schema.label: Tiles
schema.help: Square: two by two where the tiles fit as squares, a tile taller than square when its words need it, the tiles of a row of one height. Where two do not fit — a narrow column beside the words, a phone — they stand one under another as tall as their words.

schema.label: Photo
schema.help: Across the whole section, under a shade that keeps the words readable. Without a photo the section is the colour of the shade.

schema.label: Shade
schema.help: Dark: light words on a darkened photo. Light: dark words on a lightened one. Gradient: dark behind the words, fading to the clear photo on the other side; on a narrow screen, where the tiles stand under the words, it is the dark shade. The dark scheme of the site turns them round.

schema.label: Parallax
schema.help: The photo moves a little slower than the page as it scrolls, drawn slightly larger so its edges stay out of sight. Never for visitors who ask for less motion.

schema.label: Parallax strength
schema.help: How far behind the page the photo falls.

schema.label: Without animation
schema.help: Shown at once, even where the theme brings its blocks in as the page scrolls.

schema.label: Slide over the section above
schema.help: The section above stays in place while this one comes up over it, and its words fade. The edge pictures stand over this section's top. Visitors who ask for less motion see the sections one after another.

schema.label: Edge picture
schema.help: Over the top of this section, as wide as the page: fog or clouds in a PNG or WebP with transparency, its bottom row in the colour of this section.

schema.label: Edge picture on a phone
schema.help: The same edge for a narrow screen. Without it the edge picture above is used there too.

sample.heading: Room to live, ==close to everything==
sample.text: A line on what makes it worth a visit, and one more on who it suits.

tiles.label: To the park
tiles.note: On foot, by a quiet street.

tiles.label: Parking places
tiles.note: Under the house, with a charger.

tiles.label: Concierge
tiles.note: Someone at the door day and night.
